    length = int(reader.readline())
    input_str = reader.readline().rstrip('\n')
    longest = 0
    words = 0
    outCount = 0
    inCount = 0
    inParen = False
    
    for idx in range(length):
        current = input_str[idx]
        if current == '(':
            inParen = True
            outCount = 0
        elif current == ')':
            inParen = False
            if inCount > 0:
                words += 1
                inCount = 0
        else:
            if inParen:
                if current != '_':
                    inCount += 1
                else:
                    if inCount > 0:
                        words += 1
                        inCount = 0
            else:
                if current != '_':
                    outCount += 1
                    if outCount > longest:
                        longest = outCount
                else:
                    outCount = 0
    
    print(longest)
    print(words)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
